arxiv-1403-7680.title: Omega risk model with tax
arxiv-1403-7680.creator: Zhenyu Cui
arxiv-1403-7680.description: Abstract In this paper we study the Omega risk model with surplus-dependent tax payments in a time-homogeneous diffusion setting. The new model incorporates practical features from both the Omega risk model(Albrecher and Gerber and Shiu ( ? )) and the risk model with tax(Albrecher and Hipp ( ? )).

Our sample of 59 star-forming galaxies ( z med = 2.29 z_{\mathrm{med}}=2.

arxiv-2106-03597.title: Determination of approximate quantum labels based on projections of the total angular momentum on the molecule-fixed axis
arxiv-2106-03597.creator: Eamon K. Conway, Iouli E. Gordon, Oleg L. Polyansky, Jonathan Tennyson
arxiv-2106-03597.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Eamon K. Conway, Iouli E. Gordon, Oleg L. Polyansky, Jonathan Tennyson. Molecular line lists, particularly those computed for high temperature applications, often have very few states assigned local quantum numbers. These are often important components for accurately determining line shape parameters required for radiative transfer simulations. The projection of the total angular momentum onto the molecule fixed axis ( k k ) is investigated in the Radau internal coordinate system to determine when it can be considered a good quantum number.

arxiv-2112-05206.title: Causal Geodesics in Cylindrically Symmetric Vacuum Spacetimes Using Hamilton-Jacobi Formalism
arxiv-2112-05206.creator: Ashiqul Islam Dip, Nishat Anjum, Maruf Ahmed, Iffat Zumarradah
arxiv-2112-05206.description: Abstract Cylindrically symmetric vacuum spacetimes are of immense interest in theoretical physics due to its connection to cosmic strings hypothesized in quantum field theory. In this article, we explore the properties of such a spacetime and provide the complete, exact solution by quadrature to the timelike and lightlike geodesics in it, using the Hamilton-Jacobi formalism.

arxiv-2207-11817.title: A Multiple-Entanglement Routing Framework for Quantum Networks
arxiv-2207-11817.creator: Tu N. Nguyen, Kashyab J. Ambarani, Linh Le, Ivan Djordjevic, Zhi-Li Zhang
arxiv-2207-11817.description: Abstract Quantum networks are gaining momentum in finding applications in a wide range of domains. However, little research has investigated the potential of a quantum network framework to enable highly reliable communications. The goal of this work is to investigate and design the multiple entanglement routing framework, namely k k -entangled routing.

arxiv-2307-06052.title: Visualization for Multivariate Gaussian Anomaly Detection in Images * These authors equally contributed to this work.
arxiv-2307-06052.creator: João P C Bertoldo *, David Arrustico *
arxiv-2307-06052.description: Abstract This paper introduces a simplified variation of the PaDiM (Pixel-Wise Anomaly Detection through Instance Modeling) method for anomaly detection in images, fitting a single multivariate Gaussian (MVG) distribution to the feature vectors extracted from a backbone convolutional neural network (CNN) and using their Mahalanobis distance as the anomaly score.

arxiv-2308-12599.title: Exploiting Time-Frequency Conformers for Music Audio Enhancement Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29-November 3, 2023, O
arxiv-2308-12599.creator: Yunkee Chae, Junghyun Koo, Sungho Lee, Kyogu Lee
arxiv-2308-12599.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yunkee Chae, Junghyun Koo, Sungho Lee, Kyogu Lee. With the proliferation of video platforms on the internet, recording musical performances by mobile devices has become commonplace. However, these recordings often suffer from degradation such as noise and reverberation, which negatively impact the listening experience. Consequently, the necessity for music audio enhancement (referred to as music enhancement from this point onward), involving the transformation of degraded audio recordings into pristine high-quality music, has surged to augment the auditory experience.

arxiv-2311-18634.title: Maximal exponent of the Lorentz cones
arxiv-2311-18634.creator: Guillaume Aubrun, Jing Bai
arxiv-2311-18634.description: Abstract . We show that the maximal exponent (i.e., the minimum number of iterations required for a primitive map to become strictly positive) of the n n -dimensional Lorentz cone is equal to n n . As a byproduct, we show that the optimal exponent in the quantum Wielandt inequality for qubit channels is equal to 3 3 .

arxiv-2312-04012.title: Weyl Fermions on a Finite Lattice
arxiv-2312-04012.creator: David B. Kaplan, Srimoyee Sen
arxiv-2312-04012.description: Abstract The phenomenon of unpaired Weyl fermions appearing on the sole 2 ​ n 2n -dimensional boundary of a ( 2 ​ n + 1 ) (2n+1) -dimensional manifold with massive Dirac fermions was recently analyzed in Ref. Kaplan 2023 . In this Letter we show that similar unpaired Weyl edge states can be seen on a finite lattice.

arxiv-2412-03209.title: Existence of undercompressive travelling waves of a non-local generalised Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers equation Thanks: F. Achleitner was supported by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) via the FWF-funded SFB # F65. C. M. Cuesta and X. Diez-Izagirre thank the support by the grant PID2021-126813NB-I00 fund
arxiv-2412-03209.creator: F. Achleitner, C. M. Cuesta, X. Diez-Izagirre
arxiv-2412-03209.description: Abstract . We study travelling wave solutions of a generalised Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers equation with a non-local diffusion term and a concave-convex flux. This model equation arises in the analysis of a shallow water flow by performing formal asymptotic expansions associated to the triple-deck regularisation (which is an extension of classical boundary layer theory).

arxiv-2412-18968.title: BOUNDARY BLOW-UP SOLUTIONS OF SECOND ORDER QUASILINEAR EQUATION ON INFINITE CYLINDERS
arxiv-2412-18968.creator: Indranil Chowdhury, N. N. Dattatreya
arxiv-2412-18968.description: Abstract . This article studies large solutions, for a class of Quasi-linear equations involving p-Laplacian on the infinite cylindrical domains . We study the wellposedness of ‘weak’ large solutions on infinite cylinders by the convergence of large solutions on finite cylinders and observe that any such solution coincides with the large solution on its cross-section.

arxiv-2502-18867.title: Enhanced Transformer-Based Tracking for Skiing Events: Overcoming Multi-Camera Challenges, Scale Variations and Rapid Motion - SkiTB Visual Tracking Challenge 2025
arxiv-2502-18867.creator: Akhil Penta, Vaibhav Adwani, Ankush Chopra
arxiv-2502-18867.description: Abstract Accurate skier tracking is essential for performance analysis, injury prevention, and optimizing training strategies in alpine sports. Traditional tracking methods often struggle with occlusions, dynamic movements, and varying environmental conditions, limiting their effectiveness. In this work, we used STARK [ 10 ] (Spatio-Temporal Transformer Network for Visual Tracking), a transformer-based model, to track skiers.

arxiv-2504-16777.title: Systemic Flakiness: An Empirical Analysis of Co-Occurring Flaky Test Failures Thanks: Owain and Phil are supported by the EPSRC grant "Test FLARE" (EP/X024539/1).
arxiv-2504-16777.creator: Owain Parry, Gregory M. Kapfhammer, Michael Hilton, Phil McMinn
arxiv-2504-16777.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Owain Parry, Gregory M. Kapfhammer, Michael Hilton, Phil McMinn. Flaky tests produce inconsistent outcomes without code changes, creating major challenges for software developers. An industrial case study reported that developers spend 1.28% of their time repairing flaky tests at a monthly cost of $2,250. We discovered that flaky tests often exist in clusters, with co-occurring failures that share the same root causes, which we call systemic flakiness .

britannica-1911-lindsey-theophilus.title: Lindsey, Theophilus (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-lindsey-theophilus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lindsey-theophilus.description: Article 'Lindsey, Theophilus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born in Middlewich, Cheshire, on the 20th of June 1723, and was educated at the Leeds Free School and at St John’s College, Cambridge, where in 1747 he became a fellow. For some time he held a curacy in Spitalfields, London, and from 1734 to 1756 he travelled on the continent of Europe as tutor to the young duke of Northumberland.

pmc-10694651.title: Complete revascularization in elderly patients with myocardial infarction—a safe, effective, and necessary strategy?
pmc-10694651.creator: Ying X Gue, Gregory YH Lip
pmc-10694651.description: The FIRE trial compared culprit-only revascularization to physiology-guided complete revascularization strategy in elderly patients presenting with myocardial infarction. The study has shown that it is a safe approach and may confer additional prognostic benefit in patients with NSTEMI. Main text With an aging population, the population presenting to medical facilities with acute coronary syndromes (ACSs) is also gradually getting older.

pmc-10738597.title: LGBITQ+ INCLUSIVITY IN GERIATRIC CARE IN NORWAY: ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES AMONG HEALTH CARE PERSONNEL
pmc-10738597.creator: Janne Bromseth
pmc-10738597.description: Person-centered care is the dominating care philosophical framework being used in geriatric care services in Norway today, as a point of departure for good practice. It implies that all care-receivers should be met from an empathic and individual perspective- and an increased focus on basic psychological needs.

pmc-10748684.title: Clinical Association of Achilles Tendinopathy and Hypertension Mediated by CaV1.2 Voltage-gated Ca2+ Channel
pmc-10748684.creator: David J Ciufo, Chike Cao, Christopher Mendias, Haiyin Li
pmc-10748684.description: Category:Basic Sciences/Biologics; HindfootIntroduction/Purpose:The Achilles tendon is subject to acute- and overuse-injuries, which may result in degenerative tendinopathy. Achilles tendinopathy is associated with pain, disability, and functional limitations. While some patients benefit from therapy and conservative measures, many progress to operative intervention. The pathogenic mechanisms of Achilles tendinopathy are largely unknown. Using novel transgenic mouse models with CaV1.

pmc-11319355.title: Defects tune the acidic strength of amorphous aluminosilicates
pmc-11319355.creator: Rishi Verma, Charvi Singhvi, Amrit Venkatesh, Vivek Polshettiwar
pmc-11319355.description: Crystalline zeolites have high acidity but limited utility due to microporosity, whereas mesoporous amorphous aluminosilicates offer better porosity but lack sufficient acidity. In this work, we investigated defect engineering to fine-tune the acidity of amorphous acidic aluminosilicates (AAS). Here we introduced oxygen vacancies in AAS to synthesize defective acidic aluminosilicates (D-AAS).

pmc-11484785.title: The combined effects of heatwaves, air pollution and greenery on the risk of frailty: a national cohort study
pmc-11484785.creator: Weifang Dai, Shanna Liu, Weina Xu, Yuqiang Shen, Xiao Yang, Qingli Zhou
pmc-11484785.description: The associations between heatwaves and frailty, as well as the joint effects of heatwaves with air pollution and greenery, are currently unknown. This study leverages data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), which collected information from 6,400 older adults between 2011 and 2018. Our outcome variable was frailty, as measured by the frailty index (FI > 0.21).

pmc-11607795.title: Soluble suppression of tumorigenicity 2 associated with microvascular obstruction in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
pmc-11607795.creator: Xinjia Du, Jiahua Liu, Jingfang Zhou, Yanfei Ren, Nauman Gul, Lei Chen, Yuan Lu
pmc-11607795.description: BackgroundMicrovascular obstruction (MVO) develops in approximately 50% of patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) after undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). MVO is strongly linked to inflammation, myocardial fibrosis, and adverse clinical outcomes. Soluble suppression of tumorigenicity 2 (sST2) serves as a biomarker for inflammation and myocardial fibrosis.

pmc-12504727.title: Evaluation of large language models within GenAI in qualitative research
pmc-12504727.creator: Supriya D Mehta, Souvik Paul, Enid Awiti, Sophie Young, Garazi Zulaika, Fredrick O Otieno, Penelope A Phillips-Howard, Linda Mason, Runa Bhaumik
pmc-12504727.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Large language models (LLMs) perform tasks such as summarizing information and analyzing sentiment to generate meaningful and natural responses. The application of GenAI incorporating LLMs raises potential utilities for conducting qualitative research.

pmc-12630273.title: Investigating the effects of membrane curvature inducing proteins on lipid droplets in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
pmc-12630273.creator: Laura R K Niemelä, Isabell Tunn, Alexander D Frey
pmc-12630273.description: BackgroundReticulons (Rtn1p, Rtn2p) and Yop1p are proteins shaping the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane curvature their function being to a large degree responsible for molding the membrane curvature in the tubular ER area. Lipid biosynthesis mainly takes place in the tubular parts of the ER and lipid droplets are formed in the tubular ER membrane.

pmc-12660834.title: Neuromorphic detection and cooling of microparticles in arrays
pmc-12660834.creator: Yugang Ren, Benjamin Siegel, Ronghao Yin, Qiongyuan Wu, Jonathan Pritchett, Muddassar Rashid, James Millen
pmc-12660834.description: Micro-objects levitated in a vacuum are an exciting platform for precision sensing due to their low dissipation motion and the potential for control at the quantum level. Arrays of such sensors would offer increased sensitivity, directionality, and in the quantum regime the potential to exploit correlation and entanglement.

pmc-12730766.title: Safety of COVID-19 vaccines among pregnant individuals in Quebec, Canada: a population-based retrospective cohort study from the Canadian Immunization Research Network
pmc-12730766.creator: Marilou Kiely, Ella Diendere, Isaora Dialahy, Gentiane Perrault-Sullivan, Nicholas Brousseau, Shu Qin Wei, Denis Talbot, Amélie Boutin, Caroline Quach, Sarah Jorgensen, Isabelle Boucoiran
pmc-12730766.description: ObjectiveTo estimate the association between maternal COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy and adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes.DesignPopulation-based retrospective cohort study using a hospitalisation database linked with other health administrative databases.SettingProvince of Quebec, Canada, from 1 May 2021 to 30 June 2023.

pmc-13137805.title: Activated Platelet–Released Heat Shock Protein 90α Triggers Autophagy‐Dependent Neutrophil Extracellular Trap Formation and Amplifies Sepsis
pmc-13137805.creator: Chengbo Wang, Maodong Leng, Chenchen Sun, Jingyu Cao, Linfei Li, Yangyang Jia, Yongshuai Han, Yuchun Liu, Yaodong Zhang, Chenglong Zhang, Yingli Men, Ningyuan Liu, Yibing Cheng, Yixia Zhang, Ya Li, Zhenlong Li, Lidan Cui, Xiangzhan Zhu
pmc-13137805.description: Platelets are crucial to the development of thrombosis and coagulation abnormalities in sepsis, but the mechanisms by which they contribute to these pathological processes are not fully understood. Here, we identify a key role for platelet‐released heat shock protein 90α (HSP90α) in driving neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation and supporting thromboinflammation during sepsis.

pmc-13440246.title: A European collaborative initiative to systematically map cancer risk by migration background: the Cancer RADAR project
pmc-13440246.creator: Catharina Johanna Alberts, Damien Georges, Freddie Bray, Andrea Bordoni, Marià Carulla Aresté, Maria Dolores Chirlaque López, Joanna Didkowska, Jaume Galceran, Koen Van Herck, Enrica Migliore, Laura Ortelli, Lorenzo Richiardi, Antonia Sánchez Gil, Freija Verdoodt, Otto Visser, Urszula Wojciechowska,
pmc-13440246.description: BackgroundThe World Health Organization (WHO) Action Plan for Refugee and Migrant Health highlights the need for strengthened migration health governance and data-informed policies. A major barrier in Europe has been the lack of systematically collected and comparable cancer data stratified by migration background.

pmc-13640204.title: Percutaneous inside-out meniscal repair without a posterior safety incision: clinical outcomes and safety profile
pmc-13640204.creator: Eren Yalcin, Muhammet Bozoglan, Aydin Ozgur Dogan, Ogulcan Parlar, Vadym Zhamilov, Ali Turgut
pmc-13640204.description: BackgroundMeniscal repair has increasingly replaced meniscectomy because of its superior long-term clinical outcomes and protective effects against osteoarthritis. The inside-out technique is widely considered the gold standard due to its strong biomechanical fixation and versatility. However, the conventional technique requires a posteromedial or posterolateral safety incision to protect neurovascular structures, which increases surgical invasiveness and technical complexity.

pmc-13669528.title: A Multi‐Axis Plantar Load Measurement Platform for the Assessment of Foot Disorders: Comparison of Patients With Psoriatic Arthritis to a Healthy Control Cohort
pmc-13669528.creator: Dominic Jones, Lefan Wang, Max Houghton, Jennifer Jones, Richard A. Wilkins, Heidi J. Siddle, Graham J. Chapman, Ali Alazmani, Peter Culmer, Philip S. Helliwell
pmc-13669528.description: BackgroundAccurate assessment of plantar loading, including shear forces, is crucial for understanding foot pathologies such as dactylitis in psoriatic arthritis (PsA). Existing devices predominantly measure plantar pressures, neglecting important shear stresses which may initiate dactylitis. This study presents a novel multi‐axis plantar load measurement platform to address this gap.

uslaw-usc-t15-s2.title: 15 U.S.C. § 2 — Monopolizing trade a felony; penalty
uslaw-usc-t15-s2.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s2.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 1 (Monopolies And Combinations In Restraint Of Trade). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Every person who shall monopolize, or attempt to monopolize, or combine or conspire with any other person or persons, to monopolize any part of the trade or commerce among the several States, or with foreign nations, shall be deemed guilty.

uslaw-usc-t30-s1240.title: 30 U.S.C. § 1240 — Emergency powers
uslaw-usc-t30-s1240.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s1240.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 25 (Surface Mining Control And Reclamation); Subchapter IV (Abandoned Mine Reclamations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary is authorized to expend moneys from the fund for the emergency restoration, reclamation, abatement, control, or prevention of adverse effects of coal mining practices, on eligible lands, if the Secretary makes a finding.
